title: Project
description: Individual project definition in the ecosystem registry. The id must match the filename (without .json) and the key used in the assembled ecosystem config.

id.description: Canonical project identifier. Must match the filename (without .json) and the key in the assembled ecosystem config.

repository.description: GitHub repository name under the configured username. Omit when the project has no repository.

repositoryVisibility.description: Whether the repository can be publicly accessed. Required with, and only allowed with, repository. Independent of listing, status and deployments.

path.description: Path of the project inside a shared repository.

deployments.description: Public deployments. Omit when the project is not deployed.

key.description: must not be empty or whitespace-only

subdomain.description: must be one or more lowercase DNS labels separated by '.' (a-z, 0-9, '-', not starting or ending with '-')

name.description: Deployment identity, unique across the ecosystem.

subdomain.description: must be null (apex/root domain) or one or more lowercase DNS labels separated by '.' (a-z, 0-9, '-', not starting or ending with '-')

aliases.description: Additional subdomains that resolve to this deployment.

localizedText.description: Localized text. English is required; Indonesian is optional. Consumers fall back to English when a locale is missing.

meaningfulString.description: must not be empty or whitespace-only

httpsUrl.description: must be an absolute https:// URL with a host and no whitespace

technologies.description: Technologies used, in display order. Free-form names; duplicates are rejected case-insensitively.

tags.description: Lowercase kebab-case identifiers, in display order.

items.description: must be a lowercase kebab-case identifier (a-z, 0-9, single '-' between parts)

projectLinks.description: Extra project links keyed by lowercase name (e.g. documentation, figma). Do not repeat repository or deployment URLs; those are derived from existing fields.

propertyNames.description: must be a lowercase link name (a-z, 0-9, '-', starting with a letter)
